items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Bud Friedman used to say, what are you trying to prove? Now Bud's dancing around and telling jokes.

ctx.x: Yeah. But I mean, just the fact that you got up and cracked these jokes and keep the audience entertained, even in the interaction. Well, they say it's boring.

Bud Friedman used to say, what are you trying to prove? Now Bud's dancing around and telling jokes. And he's singing, I hear. I don't know. I don't know. There was a little professional jealousy in a lot of boys. Every time I worked with them, I don't know what it was. I don't know whether maybe I was gifted a little more on the ball. And then we had a couple of big name bands who used to come in and Nick said, what are you guys trying to prove with that Dixieland two beat stuff? I says, to me, Dixieland ain't…
That's all you don't have to use if you don't want to do anything you have to.
